sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Parking, Move Over, Steer It-Clear It

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
A marked stall is the first parking choice, while roadway parking demands hugging within 18 inches of the curb [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint park-basics; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Crosswalks and driveway fronts ban parking for access, while out-of-town bridges and tunnels ban it for clearance [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint banned-places; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F06 and sec07-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A01
Double parking beside another car is banned, while single-file parking belongs tight to the curb [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint park-basics; prereq_hint sec07-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F02 and sec07-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A01
The hydrant needs five feet of clearance, while the stop sign needs 10 feet [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint park-distances; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec07-F09 and sec07-F10.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A01
A firehouse mouth needs 20 feet of clearance, while a railroad crossing needs 50 feet [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint park-distances; prereq_hint sec07-F09; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec07-F11 and sec07-F12.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A01
Posted zones and intersections ban parking by sign, while sidewalks and interstates ban it by kind [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint banned-places; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F13 and sec07-F14.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A01
Only a disability permit opens a reserved space, while every other listed place stays closed to all [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint banned-places; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F15.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
Flashing stopped rigs demand a lane change first, while an impossible shift drops you to a slow, stop-ready crawl [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec07-F16 and sec07-F17.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Tow and work rigs with flashers trigger move-over, and so does an ordinary car blinking its hazards [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint sec07-F16; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec07-F16.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A02
The slowdown sets no number, only reasonable and proper, while the penalty sets a full year off the road [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F17 and sec07-F18.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A02
Operable cars must clear the lanes after a no-injury crash, because each blocked minute lifts secondary-crash odds by roughly 2.8 percent [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint clear-it; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec07-F19 and sec07-F20.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0022]
